note: Sign-in messages a game's server receives — from the web SDK's Elo.signIn (Ethereum and Solana) and the launcher's prove — and what POST /api/signin/check answers for each, with `now` (unix seconds) pinned. `expect.code` names the refusal; `signature_ok: false` marks a case whose fields check out but whose signature does not cover the text sent. meter/test_signin_check.py runs every case through the route; the SDKs test their checkSignIn calls against these shapes. The keys are throwaway test keys (0x11…11 and Ed25519 seed 07…07): never fund them.

web_sdk.note: cases[0] and cases[1] are byte for byte what elo-3.js's Elo.signIn({ nonce }) composes on a page at https://game.example, at the case's issued_at, for an Ethereum and a Solana wallet holding these keys (sdk/js/test/web.test.js pins it). The server's parser reads the same bytes, so neither side moves without this file.
